description: This file defines command-line interface components for microphone management, including listing available microphones and setting the default input device index, utilizing AVFoundation's AVCaptureDevice for device discovery.

classes.name: MicCommand
classes.description: Main command grouping microphone management subcommands.

classes.name: MicList
classes.description: Command to list available microphone input devices.

classes.name: MicSet
classes.description: Command to set the default microphone input device using device index.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes listing of audio input devices or setting the default device index.

methods.name: configURL
methods.description: Constructs the URL for the configuration file based on provided path.
